author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Google AI Studio's Voice Generator to create realistic AI voices, customize voice styles, and generate conversations between multiple speakers in this beginner-friendly tutorial.

Google AI Studio makes it easy to transform a simple text prompt into natural-sounding audio, for free. You can create professional voiceovers, voicemail greetings, podcast conversations, training videos, and much more!

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to:
 - Access Google AI Studio's AI voice generator.
 - Convert text into realistic AI-generated speech.
 - Choose different AI voices and customize their delivery.
 - Use voice style instructions to control tone, personality, pacing, and emotion.
 - Create different versions of the same voice, from professional to energetic.
 - Generate conversations between two AI speakers.
 - Download your finished audio.
